history.p: Originally Gade had planned a work in three parts with the title "Baldur", but for unknown reasons he only finished the first part, which he in the programme explicit called "1ste Afdeling: Baldurs Drøm" (Part One: Baldur's Dream). A vocal score was not printed until after Gade's death.

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper: 18 staves. With numerous corrections. After the final double bar-line on p. 32 Gade has written: "Ende paa 1ste Deel. Færdig / mod Slutningen / af 1857". / Gade's musical signature. Including a sheet with comments to the vocal score (Gades Samling 245).

Bound in cardboard cover with marbled sides and leather spine and corners. On the front cover a gold framed label inscribed: "N.W. Gade / INDLEDNINGSSCENE / AF / 'BALDURS DRØM' / PARTITUR". Stamped in gold the monogram of King Christian X. Written in ink. Paper: 20 staves. Paginated 1-19. Last page blank. Above the music on p. 2 added in pencil "Componeret 1856". Title page in Emil Erslev's hand, "componeret / 1756 (1857)" in Gade's hand.

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink with emendations in pencil and blue crayon. Heading on p. 1: "Indledning Baldur." After the double bar-line on p. 20 signed and dated "[Gade's musical signatur] / 1878." followed by 2 blank pages. From here paginated pp. 15-56. At the top of p. 15 added in pencil: "nb se Gades Manuskript!" After the last double bar-line on p. 56 Gade has written: "Ende paa 1ste Deel / d. 25 Marts 1858 [Gade's musical signature] / Componeret Sommeren 1857. / først instrumenteret færdig Marts 1858.".

annot.p: Partly in Gade's hand and partly in the hand of his Swedish pupil Jacob Adolf Hägg (1850-1928).
